title: Why 14 is one ten and four ones
examples: Why is 14 written with a 1 and a 4?

explain.say: 14 is written with a 1 and a 4. Look at the board. You see 1 long rod and 4 small cubes. Together they make 14. The rod is a ten. The cubes are ones.

draw.text: Why 14 is one ten and four ones

explain.say: This picture shows base-ten blocks. A long rod is a ten. A small cube is a one. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.

draw.text: Why 14 is one ten and four ones

explain.say: This long rod is 10 small cubes joined in a line. We call it a ten. You can see 10 at once, without counting each cube.
Now add 4 single cubes. They are called ones. 1 ten and 4 ones make 14. The 1 in 14 means 1 ten. The 4 means 4 ones.
Now look at 17. You see 1 rod and 7 cubes. That is 1 ten and 7 ones. Every number from 11 to 19 has 1 ten. How many ones does 19 have?
When the ones reach 10, they make a new rod. Now there are 2 tens. That is 20. In Chinese, 14 is said as ten four. Now build 16 with 1 ten and 6 ones.

faq.a: Teen numbers are 13 to 19, whose English names end in teen. Like 11 and 12, each one is one ten and some ones.
17 has 1 ten and 7 ones. The 1 tells you the tens, and the 7 tells you the ones.

faq.q: Why is 14 written with a 1 and a 4?
faq.a: Because the left digit counts tens and the right digit counts ones. 14 is 1 ten and 4 ones, so we write 1 then 4.

faq.q: Why do we say fourteen with the four first?
faq.a: English says the ones part first in teen names, which can be confusing. Chinese, Japanese and Korean say ten four, which matches how it is written.

faq.q: What is a base ten rod?
faq.a: It is a block made of 10 small cubes joined in a line. It shows one ten, so you can see numbers without counting every cube.
asks: What do the long blocks mean?

facts: Every number from 10 to 19 has exactly one ten.
In Chinese, 14 is said shi si, meaning ten four.

quiz.say: Look at the number 18. How many ones does it have?

wrong.0: 1 is the number of tens in 18.
wrong.2: 18 is the whole number. It is 1 ten and 8 ones.

quiz.say: You have 1 ten and 5 ones. What number is that?

wrong.0: 6 counts the ten as a one. A ten is worth 10.
wrong.1: 51 is 5 tens and 1 one. The tens digit comes first.
